description: This file defines a Java interface for reading share account dividend data within the Fineract platform. It provides method signatures for retrieving dividend details and paginated dividend data, acting as a platform service interface.

classes.name: ShareAccountDividendReadPlatformService
classes.description: A Java interface defining methods for retrieving share account dividend data, including dividend details and paginated data.

methods.name: retriveDividendDetailsForPostDividents
methods.description: Returns a list of dividend details, possibly for posting dividends.

methods.name: retriveAll
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all share account dividend data based on provided search parameters.
